reason: Choose A as the coherent composition direction: it best preserves the central crystal ball while keeping the complete omen or unavailable message visible at normal and 200% text. Baseline retains stronger artwork presentation and navigation, and earns the higher populated aggregate score; A wins composition through its enlarged-text balance. Preserve baseline’s labeled navigation and illustrated depth. Resolve the zero-readings action ambiguity. No variant meets the requested threshold across screens and components.
limitations: Independent assessment uses only the eight attached images and supplied facts; no implementation, delegation, prior ratings, or other graders were consulted.
Each state/variant score jointly considers normal and 200% captures; B also includes its expanded captures. Component score vectors use the same six dimensions as the screen.

Feedback grades cover visible status, recovery copy, and captured disclosure indicators only. Null denotes no applicable demonstrated feedback for that component; it is not a passing interaction grade.

Alternatives are static proposals. Illustrative navigation receives visual clarity/accessibility assessment only. Actual reading, focus, keyboard operation, announcements, persistence, loading, animation, and recovery behavior remain ungraded.

Screenshot clipping is observable; whether scrolling exposes the obscured content is unverified. Gate caps are conservative judgments of the supplied rendered states, not claims that the underlying app permanently blocks access.

Baseline runtime evidence is supplied rather than independently reproduced and is not transferred to alternatives. Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native behavior, and representative novice testing remain unverified; these results do not certify native 9/10 quality.
